fixed.explanation: The three guards in _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance reject only negative tolerances, so 0 is valid, but the error message said "must be positive". I changed the message to "tolerance must be non-negative" in all three branches (datetime-like, integer and float keys), so it matches what the guards accept.

query.intent: Validation of the tolerance argument in merge_asof's _AsOfMerge (_validate_tolerance / _get_merge_keys) raises MergeError("tolerance must be positive") when tolerance is negative; zero is accepted. The message should be changed to say "non-negative".
query.symptom: merge_asof raises MergeError "tolerance must be positive" for negative tolerance even though tolerance=0 is accepted, so the message is inconsistent with the guard.

history.analysis: _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance contains the three guards raising MergeError("tolerance must be positive") while only rejecting negative values. Changing the message to "tolerance must be non-negative" in all three places fixes the issue.
